name: integrity_monitor_miss
description: Navigation integrity cross-check misses a spoofed solution
basis: assumption: missed-detection probability per spoofing episode

name: gnss_spoof
description: GNSS signals spoofed so both units compute a false position (effect level)
basis: assumption: RF-domain effect; no ATT&CK for ICS technique

name: compromise_maintenance_laptop
description: Maintenance laptop used for software loads is compromised
basis: assumption: transient maintenance asset exposed to removable media

name: supply_chain_implant
description: Implant in a bus-connected unit before delivery
basis: assumption: long lead time and high capability needed

name: flood_bus
description: A bus node floods both channels and denies data delivery
basis: assumption: effect-level denial of service on a shared bus

name: inject_false_nav_messages

basis: assumption: spoofed reporting messages at the effect level

name: malicious_program_download
description: Modified software load transferred to the mission computer

name: defeat_load_verification
description: Software load verification accepts the modified load
basis: assumption: masquerading as a legitimate load
